system.longDesc: You mystically wield fire as a tool and a weapon.
system.requirement: Power talent: Intelligence (Fire Arcana) power focus at Expert

degree0.desc: You gain two Novice-degree Fire Arcana spells.

degree1.desc: You gain one Expert-degree Fire Arcana spell. You also gain the power focus Intelligence (Fire Arcana).

degree2.desc: You gain one Master-degree Fire Arcana spell. You can also choose one power stunt you can perform with your Fire Arcana spells for –1 SP.
